title: Bellman Ford
definition: Finds shortest paths in graphs that MAY contain negative edge weights. If you run it V times and it still updates, it detects a Negative Weight Cycle.
simpleExplanation: Like Google Maps, but if you drive down a certain road, you actually get paid money (negative weight). It makes sure you don't just drive in an infinite circle to get infinitely rich.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Bellman Ford.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Bellman Ford to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Bellman Ford into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Bellman Ford.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Bellman Ford from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
